propositions: GitHub Free org concurrency limit (20 total, 5 macOS) causes single Gerrit Verified run to queue 6.7-8.4m waiting for slots, extending 21m runs to 41-47m.
Current matrix fans out 6 jobs (5 per-extra + union), each holding a slot for checkout/setup/install while doing 0.4-0.8m real work; collapsing to one venv-loop job reduces peak slot demand.
Loop must run 7 iterations: one per key in _optional.EXTRAS union {mcp} (six isolation iterations), plus one union iteration installing [agents,eval,tracing] jointly to detect ResolutionImpossible.
Each iteration must use absolute venv paths for all interpreter/console-script calls, never source activate, and accumulate failures via rc variable with continue/exit $rc guards.
Metrics extra currently has no per-extra CI despite being in _optional.EXTRAS; loop adds new coverage.
Checked-in tests must assert loop contains exit $rc and continue and no activate, and that looped extras cover all _optional.EXTRAS keys.
